## Before you open it

- [ ] The change is focused; behaviour outside it is unchanged.
- [ ] Tests are added or updated for changed behaviour.
- [ ] Affected docs, and `CHANGELOG.md` for a user-visible change, are updated.
- [ ] Evidence is public-safe: no credentials, real customer data, private prompts, machine paths or runtime state.
- [ ] Commits and this description credit no AI tool as author or co-author, and carry no generated-by line (see `AGENTS.md`).
- [ ] I have the right to contribute this work under the Apache License 2.0, and third-party notices are kept.
